messages:
Mia Chen: Quick async standup — SDK quickstart + sample app handoff.
What I did: finished Node quickstart draft (ESM + CJS), added short walkthrough video link, wired sample app to the test harness.
Blockers: macOS CI failing on wheel build, some flaky timeout in sample app e2e.
Today: push a CI fix (pin buildx), tidy README, and hand off sample app to Samir for final CI run. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/412 :pray:

Samir Patel: Got it — I can take CI checks after your push. For the mac wheel failure, can you paste the failing log? I suspect the Python binary compile step.

Mia Chen: paste of small log snippet: `error: command '/usr/bin/clang' failed with exit code 1` — looks like header path. Trying a quick `pip wheel --no-build-isolation` change.

Samir Patel: Nice, try `CFLAGS='-I/usr/local/include'` in the build step, that helped previously. I can run a local replicate on mac-latest. :macintosh:

Leo Zhang: Quick doc nit on the quickstart: under "Authentication" can we show the `REDWOOD_API_KEY` as an env var example? e.g. `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-...` Also add a one-liner for toggling streaming responses.

Mia Chen: good call, will add both. Also adding a tiny code snippet for streaming: ``const stream = client.stream({model:'redwood-alpha', prompt}); for await (const chunk of stream) { process.stdout.write(chunk.text) }``

Anya Koval: FYI, sample app config needs a small README note about allowed CORS origins for the dev server — we had a support ticket yesterday. Could you add that under Troubleshooting?

Mia Chen: yep adding Troubleshooting section now. Will also include a link to the support ticket id #6421 for repro.

Docs Bot: CI report — integration-tests (linux) passed; mac-wheel-build failed on 2/3 runners. See: https://ci.redwood.ai/28765/1234 :rotating_light:

Samir Patel: I'll queue a mac replicate and post results here. If I can reproduce locally I'll open a helper branch and ping for review.

Mia Chen: thanks — plan: push quick fixes in next 30m, then @Samir run replicate. If all green I'll mark the PR ready for docs review. Anything else?

Leo Zhang: LGTM, just the auth + streaming + cors notes. No blockers from my side. :thumbsup:

Anya Koval: +1, happy to take a final pass on the README language after your edits.

Samir Patel: reproducer started, will update in ~20m.

Mia Chen: perfect — will update the PR and tag reviewers when CI passes. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
